title: Hearthhands Library: 9 Villager Sprite Packs, Every New One
short_text: 9 villager sprite packs in one download, every new Hearthhands pack added free
description:
9 Hearthhands villager sprite packs in one download: 98 animated townsfolk and 38 portraits, Godot 4 and RPG Maker MZ files, worth $65.25 one by one. Royalty free in commercial games, no credit required. This page is $14.99. The CSAF Sprite Library ($19.99) includes this family and every other CSAF sprite pack.

Buy once, keep every Hearthhands pack that joins.

How the future packs work

  • When a new Hearthhands pack comes out, its files are added to this page on launch day.
  • You do not pay again. Open your itch.io library and the new files are there.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

Bought the two-pack Hearthhands Collection on this page before 2026-11-07? The same download now holds all 9 packs at no extra cost.

Latest additions

  • 2026-11-20: The Working Year (Field and Orchard) joins with 1,180 PNG frames and sheets. New here first: it has no page of its own yet.
  • 2026-11-07: the Hearthhands Collection grows from 2 packs to 8, 9,991 PNG frames and sheets.

What's inside (9 packs)

Hearthhands 01 to 05: the working villagers, five numbered packs (5 packs, $39.95 one by one): Hearthhands 01: The Working Day, 200x200 & 100x100 villager sprites; Hearthhands 02: Market and Craft, 200x200 & 100x100 villager sprites; Hearthhands 03: 10 Townsfolk Sprites [200 & 100 px]; Hearthhands 04: Hearth and Kin, 200x200 & 100x100 village family sprites; Hearthhands 05: Harbour Hands, 200x200 & 100x100 harbour NPC sprites.

The volumes (Side, The Working Year), the Hallowtide costumed village and the portraits (4 packs, $25.30 one by one): Hearthhands Hallowtide: 10 Halloween Villager Sprites; Hearthhands Portraits: 38 Dialogue Sprites [64 & 128 px]; Hearthhands Side: Town, Keep and Road; The Working Year, a Hearthhands villagers volume (new here first).

What a pack contains

Every pack sits in its own folder exactly as its own page delivers it: PNG frames and sheets at their native grid sizes (64x64 up to 200x200), a frames.json map, its own Readme and its own licence. Hearthhands 01 to 05, Hallowtide and The Working Year are top down: four directions, with idle, walk and a job loop for every character (Watch and Ward adds strike and hurt). The Side volume is side view, east and west, with idle, walk and job, plus attack, hurt and death on some of its cast. 8 packs carry Godot 4 SpriteFrames and 8 carry RPG Maker MZ sheets; every pack works in any engine that reads PNG, including Unity and GameMaker. CATALOGUE.md lists every folder and its page.

Licence

You can use the sprites in commercial and personal games, as many projects as you like, with no royalty and no credit required, and edit them freely. You can't resell or share the sprites themselves as an asset pack, or use them to train a model. Each pack's own LICENSE.txt governs its folder.

The art in all 9 packs is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, on a paid plan that grants commercial use), then palette locked and checked by our own tooling. The tooling was written with AI assistance.

Try before you buy

Free villagers from the same family: Hearthhands Sampler: 6 Free Villager Sprites [200 & 100 px].

Questions: post a comment below. A trade you want next: the Request Desk. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

$14.99. Buyers keep every Hearthhands pack that joins.

Shipping on Steam? Steam's Content Survey asks you to describe content made with the help of AI tools that ships in your game, and the note above says how these sprites were made. A line you can adapt: "Some sprites in this game come from a third party asset library and were generated with an AI pixel art model."

Made something with this? Post it below and we will add it to our Made With collection.

devlog.title: Hearthhands Library: The Working Year, Field and Orchard, joins, 9 packs now
devlog.html:
The Working Year (Field and Orchard) is now in the Hearthhands Library: ten top-down villagers who visibly do their work, each with an idle, a walk and a job loop in four facings. The Library now holds 9 packs, worth $65.25 bought one by one, for $14.99. If you own it, download it again from your itch.io library: it is in volumes-portraits-seasonal/hearthhands-the-working-year/.

  • 1,040 frame PNGs and 60 sheets at 200x200 and 100x100, with 10 Godot 4 SpriteFrames per grid (20 in all) and 20 RPG Maker MZ character sheets.
  • The cast: beekeeper with a tin smoker, farm lad with a bird rattle, orchard picker with a basket of apples, old gleaner with a sheaf of wheat, haymaker with a wooden pitchfork, orchard pruner with long shears, reaper with a long scythe, sower with a basket of seed, gardener with a watering can and winnower with a wide grain basket.
  • Every character has a four-facing idle, a 6-frame walk and a 6-frame job loop, all on one 200 px cell with a shared ground row, so the cast stands at one scale beside the other Hearthhands villagers.
  • Each villager ships one side view as an exact mirror of the other side, so the tool stays in view; the Readme lists every mirrored cycle.

It is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so for now this Library and the CSAF Sprite Library are the places to get it. It is the first cast of three; Mill and Dairy and Woods and Quarry join this same folder when they are built. The characters and every cycle were generated by PixelLab, a generative AI pixel-art model, on a paid plan whose terms permit commercial use, then re-homed onto one cell, palette-locked and checked frame by frame by code.

Every new Hearthhands pack joins this page on its launch day, at no cost to anyone who owns it. The CSAF Sprite Library holds this family and every other CSAF sprite pack. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
